title: Primes of a localized polynomial fibre are irreducible factors
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f,g\in R[t]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], with $f$ monic (leading coefficient $1$), and put $A=R[t]/(f)$ and $B=A_{g_A}$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], where $g_A$ is the class of $g$. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime ideal of $B$ and $\mathfrak p$ its contraction to $R$. Put $k=\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and let $\rho:R[t]\to k[t]$ apply $R\to k$ to each coefficient. Write $f_k=\rho(f)$, $g_k=\rho(g)$ and $F=(k[t]/(f_k))_{[g_k]}$, with the canonical map $j:B\to F$. There is a unique monic irreducible polynomial $h\in k[t]$ (irreducible means nonzero and not a unit, and every factorization has a unit factor) such that $h\mid f_k$, $h\nmid g_k$, and $\mathfrak q=j^{-1}(((h)/(f_k))F)$. Here $(h)/(f_k)$ is the image of the ideal $(h)$ in $k[t]/(f_k)$ and the trailing $F$ denotes extension of this ideal to $F$. Explicitly, for every $P\in R[t]$ and $m\ge0$, one has $[P]/g_A^m\in\mathfrak q$ if and only if $h\mid\rho(P)$ in $k[t]$.
